## Notes

Already live on all three plus the desktop. It owns its own deploy script with its own exclude list and eval gate, so fleet does NOT materialize it — it records it, reports its state, and defers to `scripts/deploy.cmd`. Declared here so the Fleet matrix shows the whole picture, not most of it.
THE MEMORY MODEL (2026-09-25). Two layers, no holographic provider: built-in MEMORY.md/USER.md (always in context, shared default+jason via a junction) and this brain (searched on demand). Brains: `shared` = ~/.hermes/rag, used by default AND jason (jason/rag is a junction to it); `tiferet` = its own index, restricted by rag/legs.txt to Construction and never indexing Sessions/ transcripts. Vault `.ragignore` (or `private: true` frontmatter) keeps a note out of EVERY brain — it opens only when asked for by name.
Upkeep is Task Scheduler `BrainRAG_Nightly` (03:30) running scripts/nightly.py with Hermes' venv python: (1) spill — MEMORY.md/USER.md over 70% of cap move their longest entries to vault Memory/ (committed before the memory file is trimmed, under Hermes' own .lock); (2) sweep — ended sessions older than 7 days to <Leg>/Sessions/, secrets redacted; (3) incremental re-index of both brains. Log: ~/.hermes/rag/nightly.log. Query embeddings time out at 5 s (then BM25-only) and are cached.
